Package org.apache.logging.log4j.core.config.builder.impl

Class DefaultConfigurationBuilder<T extends BuiltConfiguration>

java.lang.Object
org.apache.logging.log4j.core.config.builder.impl.DefaultConfigurationBuilder<T>
Type Parameters:
T - The BuiltConfiguration type.
All Implemented Interfaces:
ConfigurationBuilder<T>, Builder<T>
@ProviderType public class DefaultConfigurationBuilder<T extends BuiltConfiguration> extends Object implements ConfigurationBuilder<T>
A ConfigurationBuilder implementation for building a BuiltConfiguration or a custom implementation thereof.
Since:
2.4

    • DefaultConfigurationBuilder

      public DefaultConfigurationBuilder()
      Constructs a new configuration builder using the default BuiltConfiguration as a target configuration type.

    • DefaultConfigurationBuilder

      public DefaultConfigurationBuilder(Class<T> clazz)
      Constructs a new configuration builder with the given target BuiltConfiguration implementation class.

      Note the implementation will be instantiated per reflection and must have a constructor with the following parameters: 

      
   public BuiltConfigurationClazz(LogggerContext, ConfigurationSource, Component) {
     ...
   }
      Parameters:
      clazz - the BuiltConfiguration implementation class

    • add

      public ConfigurationBuilder<T> add(AppenderComponentBuilder builder)
      Adds the Appender component built by the given AppenderComponentBuilder to this builder.

      Note: the provided builder will be built by this method; therefore, it must be fully configured before calling this method. Changes to the builder after calling this method will not have any effect.

      Specified by:
      add in interface ConfigurationBuilder<T extends BuiltConfiguration>
      Parameters:
      builder - The AppenderComponentBuilder to add with all of its attributes and subcomponents set.
      Returns:
      this builder (for chaining)
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if the builder argument is null

    • setShutdownTimeout

      public ConfigurationBuilder<T> setShutdownTimeout(long shutdownTimeoutMillis)
      Sets the configuration's "shutdownTimeout" attribute.

      The shutdown-timeout specifies how long appenders and background tasks will get to shut down when the JVM is shutting down.

      The default is zero which means that each appender uses its default timeout, and doesn't wait for background tasks. Not all appenders will honor this, it is a hint and not an absolute guarantee that the shutdown procedure will not take longer.

      Setting the shutdown-timeout too low increase the risk of losing outstanding log events that have not yet been written to the final destination.

      This setting is ignored if ConfigurationBuilder.setShutdownHook(String) has been set to "disable".

      Specified by:
      setShutdownTimeout in interface ConfigurationBuilder<T extends BuiltConfiguration>
      Parameters:
      shutdownTimeoutMillis - the shutdown timeout in milliseconds
      Returns:
      this builder (for chaining)
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the shutdownTimeoutMillis argument is invalid
      See Also:
      • LoggerContext.stop(long, TimeUnit)
